**Position Title:** Finance Manager / Plant Finance Manager  
**Department:** Finance & Accounts

**Employment Type:** Full-Time [1]**Job Purpose**The Finance Manager will oversee and own the end-to-end financial operations, cost accounting, statutory compliance, treasury, and strategic reporting for the manufacturing unit.

**Responsibilities**1. Cost Accounting & Plant Economics

* **Product Costing:** Manage standard and actual product costing, bill of materials (BOM) analysis, overhead allocation, and labor-to-machine cost tracking.
* **Variance Analysis:** Conduct deep-dive variance analysis (Material Price/Usage, Labor, and Production Overhead variances) and report actionable insights to plant/operations heads.
* **Inventory Valuation:** Oversee physical stock audits, valuation of Raw Materials (RM), Work-In-Progress (WIP), and Finished Goods (FG), and monitor slow-moving/obsolete inventory write-offs.

2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & MIS

* **FP&A:** Lead annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, and long-term financial modeling.
* **MIS Reporting:** Prepare and present monthly, quarterly, and annual Management Information System (MIS) reports, P&L statements, balance sheets, and cash flow forecasts to the board/managing director.
* **Budget vs. Actual:** Track departmental expenditures against approved budgets and flag cost overruns proactively.

3. Treasury & Working Capital Management

* **Cash Flow & Liquidity:** Manage daily cash flows, fund allocations, and working capital cycles (Days Sales Outstanding, Days Payable Outstanding, and Inventory Days). [1]
* **Banking Relations:** Coordinate with banks and financial institutions for working capital limits, packing credit, bank guarantees, letters of credit (LC), and credit facilities. [1]
* **Forex & Trade Finance:** Monitor foreign currency exposure for import/export transactions, hedge risk, and account for Forex gains/losses (if applicable). [1]

4. Statutory Compliance & Taxation (India/Local Context)

* **Indirect Taxes:** Oversee monthly GST calculations, GSTR-1/3B filings, e-way bill compliance, ITC (Input Tax Credit) reconciliations, and custom duty/import-export documentation (EPCG, Advance Authorization, ICEGATE).
* **Direct Taxes:** Manage TDS, Advance Tax computations, and corporate income tax filings.
* **Regulatory Filings:** Ensure compliance with ROC (Registrar of Companies), Companies Act (Schedule III), and labor/payroll statutory dues (PF, PT, ESIC, Gratuity).
* **Audits:** Act as the primary point of contact for statutory, internal, cost, and tax audits. [1]

5. Team Leadership & Internal Controls

* **Team Management:** Mentor, supervise, and upskill the plant accounts and finance team (Accounts Executive, Billing/Costing staff).
* **Governance:** Strengthen internal financial controls, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and risk mitigation frameworks.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner closely with Production, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, and HR teams to drive cost discipline. [1]

**Required Qualifications & Education**

* **Education:** Chartered Accountant (CA) / Cost & Management Accountant (CMA) or MBA in Finance / Post Graduate in Commerce (M.Com).
* **Experience:** 5 to 10 years of total experience, with at least 3–4 years in a managerial or plant finance role specifically within a **manufacturing, industrial, or engineering** setup. [1]

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* **Technical Skills:**
* Strong mastery of **Cost Accounting** and inventory valuation methods in manufacturing.
* Hands-on experience with **ERP systems** (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or Tally Prime/ERP).
* Advanced **MS Excel** (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, financial modeling) and BI tools (Power BI preferred). [1]
* **Domain Knowledge:** Thorough working knowledge of Indian taxation (GST, TDS) and corporate governance (Companies Act). [1]
* **Soft Skills:** High personal integrity, sharp analytical mindset, communication skills to present to non-finance operational heads, and leadership capability.
